meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 把消息里附带的本地文档（Word、演示、表格、PDF、EPUB 等）在本地容器内转成 Markdown 文件，并把生成的文件路径返回给你，不会上传到外部解析服务。
howto.when: 当消息给出一个本地附件路径、需要读取其中内容时，它接管转换；路径须是本地文件，扫描版和纯图片 PDF 不支持。

say.text: 把 inbox 里的 report.docx 转成 Markdown
say.note: 本地转换，返回生成的 .md 路径

say.text: 这份 CSV 从 stdin 转，格式指定为 csv
say.note: 用于读取通过管道传入的 CSV

say.text: 只读转换结果里的表格部分，别全塞进上下文
say.note: 只取相关段落，节省上下文

howto.what_en: It converts a local attached document (Word, slides, spreadsheets, PDF, EPUB, etc.) into a Markdown file inside the agent container and returns the generated path; nothing is uploaded to an external parser.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a message supplies a local attachment path whose contents must be read. Scanned and image-only PDFs are unsupported.

say_en.text: Convert report.docx from the inbox to Markdown
say_en.note: Runs locally and returns the generated .md path

say_en.text: Convert this CSV from stdin, format set to csv
say_en.note: For reading CSV piped in as input

say_en.text: Only read the table sections of the converted output
